clips.title: The story
paras: Renferrel's Findings is a collection of research notes compiled by Apothecary Renferrel in Silverpine Forest. Entrusted to Horde couriers, these documents carry vital data southward to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill to assist in brewing the Forsaken's New Plague.

The Royal Apothecary Society labours tirelessly under direct orders from the Dark Lady, Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, to engineer a New Plague. Achieving this breakthrough requires constant collaboration among researchers scattered across Lordaeron. Stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, Apothecary Renferrel compiles these findings to document his progress and experiments, sending the gathered intelligence south to Tarren Mill so fellow researchers can build upon his results.

Carrying these papers across the border from Silverpine into the Hillsbrad Foothills represents a vital link in the Forsaken's alchemical network. In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon eagerly awaits Renferrel's notes to cross-reference and advance his own concoctions against the living and the Scourge. Without reliable couriers running the contested roads of Hillsbrad, the Society's decentralized research would quickly stall.
